foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat statutory filing fee of $100.00 for a foreign limited liability company's application for a certificate of authority to transact business (F.S. 605.0213(3)).
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report between January 1 and May 1 of each calendar year and continuously maintain a registered office and registered agent in this state.

evidence.quote: (3) For filing a foreign limited liability company's application for a certificate of authority to transact business, $100.

A foreign limited liability company may apply for a certificate of authority to transact business in this state by delivering an application to the department for filing. Such application must be made on forms prescribed by the department.

The first annual report must be delivered to the department between January 1 and May 1 of the year following the calendar year in which the limited liability company's articles of organization became effective or the foreign limited liability company obtained a certificate of authority to transact business in this state. Subsequent annual reports must be delivered to the department between January 1 and May 1 of each calendar year thereafter.
Each limited liability company and each foreign limited liability company that has a certificate of authority under s. 605.0902 shall designate and continuously maintain in this state:

notes: Collected on the statute route: F.S. 605.0213(3) sets the $100.00 fee and F.S. 605.0902 names the application for a certificate of authority and the Department of State as the filing office (F.S. 605.0102(16) defines the department). A certificate of existence or similar record dated not more than 90 days before delivery must accompany the application (F.S. 605.0902(2)). The Department of State's Sunbiz pages are bot-walled on the collecting route, so the record carries the statutory $100.00; whether the online filing adds a separate $25.00 registered-agent designation fee is open in needsReview.
needsReview: Whether the Sunbiz online filing charges a separate $25.00 registered-agent designation fee in addition to the $100.00 application fee: F.S. 605.0213(7) prices a certificate designating or changing a registered agent at $25.00, while the initial registered agent's written acceptance is part of the application itself (F.S. 605.0902(1)(d)). Settle by reading the official Sunbiz fee page or online checkout when a browser or VPN-up route is available.
